note: Canonical skill-creator schema. Output evals verify the research-execution contract. All require live web access.

evals.prompt: Build a comprehensive SEBI compliance filing register for an NSE+BSE equity-listed company in the Top 500 by market cap. Excel format, everything a CS would need for FY26-27.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 source version gate completed first with live-fetch timestamps; XLSX with the 12-column schema, 85+ rows across 19 MECE categories; every Source URL from a primary domain and fetched this session (Gate 6); Gate 3 tripwires verified against fetched primary text; Gate 7 calibrated delivery summary distinguishing FETCHED-verified from UNVERIFIED rows.

evals.prompt: What are all the insider trading (PIT) disclosure obligations for designated persons and the company? I keep seeing conflicting timelines online for the initial disclosure.
evals.expected_output: PIT-only instantiation per Part 2; primary PIT regulation text fetched live and quoted as the authority; the 7-day Reg 7(1) initial disclosure confirmed from the fetched text (not from the skill's stored value); conflicting blog claims explicitly resolved in favour of Tier 1; timelines expressed in trading days.

evals.prompt: A debt-only listed NBFC has NCDs listed on NSE. Map its complete compliance calendar - SEBI plus exchange requirements.
evals.expected_output: Entity scope fixed to debt-only listing; NCS 2021 + LODR Reg 52-60 anchored; NSE Debt calendar read as an independent Tier 2 pass and reconciled line-by-line; CP and NCRPS tripwires from Tier A checked; applicability column correctly restricted to debt-listed obligations.

evals.prompt: Update our existing SEBI register (attached as xlsx) against whatever changed in the last 12 months - amendments, new circulars, anything.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1.4 amendment sweep run against the current consolidated version date; a Gap Analysis sheet produced showing added/changed/removed obligations with the amending instrument cited per row; version-conflict rule applied (newer amendment governs, both citations annotated).

evals.prompt: sebi site seems down for me today but I need the LODR board meeting intimation timelines for a memo in an hour - whatever you can verify
evals.expected_output: Bounded retry per 0.3 (alternate tool, then fresh search); values that could not be read from a live primary fetch are labeled UNVERIFIED with the exact URL the user should fetch; no Tier 3 source silently substituted as primary; the dual 30-min/3-hour board-meeting rule stated with both branches and its verification status.
